title: Natalia Shuman Joins Mettler Toledo Board of Directors
summary: Mettler-Toledo International Inc. (NYSE: MTD) announced today that Natalia Shuman has been appointed to its Board of Directors effective August 3, 2026. Ms. Shuman has served as President and Chief Executive Officer of MISTRAS Group, a global leader in technology-enabled industrial asset integrity solutions, since January 2025 and is a member of its Board of Directors. Prior to joining MISTRAS, she was Executive Vice President and a member of the Group Operating Council of Eurofins Scientific, a leading global provider of analytical laboratory testing services. Previously, she served as Chief Executive Officer of Bureau Veritas North America from 2017 to 2021, following more than two decades in leadership roles at Kelly Services.
